text:
anya: quick heads-up — short embeddings (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 spiking 503s since 02:12 UTC. p99 errors up, p95 ok. Suspect yesterday's quant kernel change.

ryan: how bad? customers blocking?

anya: limited but visible; about 3% of eu-west1 traffic and a couple support tickets. No DB/schema changes.

pat: can we do a revert image?

anya: prepared: redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-stable. Proposing deploy with option to skip canary if unanimous ops+eng consent: `/deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-stable --strategy canary=5%:3m --skip-canary-if-unanimous=true --reason "short-embed 503s"`

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6600000000 created by anya. Approvals required: eng-leads + ops-oncall. Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke: WARNING (503s observed).

ops-bot: paging ops rotation.

ryan: i'm oncall-adjacent, i can sign off for eng if ops approves. /approve 6600000000

pat: approve for QA/docs. /approve 6600000000 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: ops-oncall (maria) acknowledged.

maria: oncall here. Given limited blast radius and tests passing, I approve and agree to skip canary. I'll monitor traces closely and hold rollback ready. /approve 6600000000

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: ryan, pat, maria. Skip-canary condition met. Beginning immediate rollout of redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-stable to embeddings-eu. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6600000000

anya: applying image and draining subset: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-stable -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Rolling update started (skip canary). Progress: 20% -> 55% -> 100%. Healthchecks streaming: https://deploy.internal/health/6600000000

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. Healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS, no new alerts.

maria: monitoring live traces — looks stable. No rollback needed.

ryan: please add release note and send short support blurb.

pat: I'll draft a one-liner for release notes: "Embeddings: emergency revert to v2.3.2-stable to fix 503s affecting short embeddings in eu-west1. No customer data changes; warm cache post-deploy."

anya: thanks team. Will open RCA ticket for the quant kernel and follow-up test coverage. Closing after notes posted. :white_check_mark:
